title: Caribbean Draw Poker
jackpotHelp: The jackpot side bet is optional. It pays out — regardless of whether you beat the dealer — when your hand is a flush or better (flush, full house, four of a kind, straight flush, or royal flush). It is judged on your hand after the draw.

draw.guide: Pick up to {{max}} cards to exchange, or play the hand as dealt.
draw.fee: Exchange fee {{cost}} (the same as your ante). Standing pat is free.
draw.maxReached: You may exchange at most {{max}} cards.

betGuide: Set your ante and optional jackpot side bet

payoutRef.title: Payout Table
payoutRef.qualifyNote: The dealer qualifies on a pair of 8s or better.

tutorial.betControls: Set your ante and optional jackpot side bet, then press Bet.
tutorial.drawControls: Pick up to 2 cards to exchange and press Exchange, or stand pat and play the hand as dealt.
tutorial.actionButtons: Choose Call to bet 2x your ante, or Fold to forfeit.
tutorial.results: Check your results and payouts here.

hint.standPat: Stand pat: you already hold a made hand
hint.drawWeak: Consider drawing: no made hand — discard what you cannot use and go for one
